# Wagner Logistics

Wagner Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Wagner Logistics is a top 100 3PL delivering warehousing, transportation, fulfillment, and packaging solutions backed by 70+ years of expertise. Wagner Logistics employs 300 people (+7.5% YoY, +21 people) and has an annual revenue of $70M, founded in 1946. Headquartered in North Kansas City, Missouri, United States, with offices including Byhalia, Jacksonville, Charlotte, Kansas City, and Clinton. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Belgium, Chile, France, and Mexico).

## About

Wagner is a leading 3PL service provider offering distribution, warehousing, contract packaging and transportation services to Fortune 500 and small/midsized companies across a network of facilities in the United States. Wagner uses world-class technology to provide visibility and execution, delivering clients unsurpassed service from a team of highly skilled associates.

# Wagner Trucking

Wagner Trucking is a Truck Transportation company. Wagner Trucking is a company that provides trucking services. Wagner Trucking employs 20 people, founded in 1983. Headquartered in Brandon, Minnesota, United States.

## About

Wagner Trucking is a specialized transportation company utilizing special trailers like Removable Goose Necks (RGN's), Step Decks and Flat Beds. This allows Wagner Trucking to haul oversize and overweight loads. Wagner Trucking has authority to run in the lower 48 states plus Canada. This allows Wagner Trucking to help you with most specialized loads you may have.
